content: The PZL Bielsko SZD-30 was a Polish glider aircraft designed and produced in the 1960s. It was a single-seat, mid-wing glider intended for training and recreational use. The SZD-30 was produced by the PZL Bielsko aircraft manufacturer in Poland. It had a wooden airframe construction.
